noise_6step_check.diagnosis: Auto-diagnosis IMPULSE is the known extreme_pct>50% FP from JPEG/blur artefacts (reflection trigger: extreme_pct>50% AND sigma<5 -> ignore IMPULSE). var_slope=0.0014 excludes poisson; rgb_ratio/cross_ch_corr are uninformative because saturation S=0 makes all channels identical; spatial_corr=0.95 contradicts white noise (residual is structured / JPEG-like). noise_prior sigma on raw residual 1.98 < 2 -> NO_NOISE. Adding noise_gaussian_RGB:2 (R11) lowered PSNR 30.34->29.93 and CI 7/10->7/10 with no signal gain. Final: NO independent noise step.

final_decision.rationale: Deterministic 3-step pipeline, PSNR 30.34 dB falls in the 30-40 UNCERTAIN band although every content-independent signal matches. No contrast step (variance algebra: contrast c>=0.94 required to keep var_ratio 0.232, and no library severity fits while gm 0.19 is met), no brightness (mean shift fully explained by V=max grayscale), no noise (peeled §B structured residual, var_slope~0). Blur subtype gaussian:3 preferred over lens:3/glass and over severity 4 (signals over-blurred at g4 although its raw PSNR is 0.38 dB higher).

final_decision.reason: R1 signal re-interpretation corrected two R0 perceptions (glass_score is a JPEG-inflated false positive; jpeg:4 matches block_boundary better than jpeg:3) but produced no candidate meeting the deterministic change bar (>40 dB or +2 dB on 5 support pairs).
